Microsoft Advertising

Reach relevant search demand with a clear acquisition model.

MAOfficial product ↗Open in the hierarchy →
Level 4Inspect the detail

Microsoft Advertising supports paid acquisition and reporting through documented campaign and API capabilities. MoreSpace can organize intent-led campaigns, connect appropriate landing experiences, and build an acquisition scorecard that reconciles media activity with qualified enquiries and the client's commercial outcomes.

Useful outputs

  • Campaign structures with controlled budgets and consistent naming
  • Tested conversion measurements and qualified lead handoff mappings
  • Reports joining acquisition costs with pipeline or purchase outcomes

Where we can apply it

  • Search intent → reviewed campaign → relevant landing page → qualified enquiry.
  • Conversion event → eligibility checks → reporting extract → acquisition scorecard.
  • Campaign spend → CRM outcomes → attribution review → budget recommendation.
01

Use case 1

Structure paid search campaigns around relevant services, markets, and intent.

02

Use case 2

Connect eligible conversion signals and lead qualification data with reporting.

03

Use case 3

Build recurring campaign reports through approved account and API access.

Inputs we need

  • Approved search themes, target markets, and campaign budget
  • Reviewed landing pages, ad copy, and conversion objectives
  • Authorized account access and CRM qualification definitions

Delivery sequence

  • Agree search intent, account scope, and the meaningful conversion definition.
  • Build reviewed campaigns and test destinations, event quality, and authorized reporting.
  • Launch within approved budgets and inspect relevance and qualified outcomes.

Expert review points

  • Approve advertising claims, audience scope, and spending rules before activation.
  • Check OAuth permissions and reconcile attributed conversions with source records.
